name: @drakulavich/peon-pet
description: A macOS desktop pet for Peon-Ping — an orc that reacts to your Claude Code events. Native Bun + AppKit (no Electron).
author: Anton Yakutovich (drakulavich)

scripts.start: bun run build:native && bun run src/main.ts
scripts.dev: bun run build:native && bun run src/main.ts --dev
scripts.build:native: clang -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 -framework Cocoa -framework WebKit -dynamiclib -fobjc-arc -o native/libpeonshell.dylib native/peonshell.m
scripts.prepack: bun run build:native && bun run vendor:three
